verdict.rationale: Runtime portability and avoiding proprietary APIs is a fair question for a cloud deployment platform, but nothing in the evidence describes Railway supporting standard runtime APIs or code that runs unmodified across multiple edge platforms. The repo-based deploys and run-closer-to-users claims are general hosting features and do not address portability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write code against standard runtime APIs so it runs unmodified across multiple edge platforms instead of being locked into proprietary storage/runtime APIs
